propositions: Shell probe scripts/probe-rebar.sh accumulated 3 stale assertions against removed flags/keysets (08ce class) due to silent drift without a parity review mechanism.

Continue-on-failure behavior (collect all failures, report all, exit non-zero if any failed) must be preserved when porting to Python; the deliberate lack of 'set -e' must not be replaced with exception-raising semantics.

All 140 shell probe assertions must be enumerated, mapped 1:1 to the Python port, or retired with documented reason; parity verified by side-by-side run on the same build showing identical pass/fail verdicts.

All consumers of the shell path (workflows test.yml:128, gerrit-verify.yaml:209, anti-rot test substring, docs/releasing.md examples) must be atomically re-pointed to the Python entry point in the same change.

The shell probe-rebar.sh file must be retained as a 7-line transitional exec shim because gerrit-verify.yaml executes from MAIN's workflow definition, which cannot be updated until this change lands; full deletion is a separate follow-up ticket d772-6007-5d04-4101.
Self-test with PROBE_INJECT_FAIL=1 confirms harness continues past injected failure through all sections and exits non-zero (140 passed, 1 failed).
